newsitem.title: USA: John Nuveen to launch new ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: John Nuveen to launch new ad campaign.

text.p: John Nuveen Co said Monday it will launch a new advertising campaign to support its family of equity and fixed-income mutual funds.
The ads, set to appear in two national newspapers Tuesday, outline the benefits of conservative investing for individuals who have had significant market success in recent years, Nuveen said.
Information on who designed the ads and the cost of the campaign was not available.
Nuveen offers managed investment products and related services.
Its shares were unchanged Monday at 30-3/8.
